hero.headline: Earlier insight into Fatty Liver Disease through blood-based lipid biomarker science.
hero.subheadlineStrong: The Root-Cause Blood Test for Metabolic Health Your Patients Need.
hero.subheadline: Give your patients the first non-invasive, highly accurate blood test for Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD). LipoNexus is developing advanced diagnostics for fatty liver and metabolic disease, starting with a blood test designed to help identify elevated risk earlier and support proactive intervention in preventive, functional, and longevity-focused care.

problem.headline: Your Patients Are Likely Undiagnosed
problem.body: Metabolic Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) affects 1 in 3 people — yet 90% are undiagnosed because existing tests are invasive, inaccurate, or inaccessible. As a medical practitioner, you know Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD and MASH) is rooted in metabolic dysfunction and lipid dysregulation. Now you have a test that matches your root-cause approach: early, precise, and actionable.

solution.headline: A Precision Test Built for Root-Cause Medicine
solution.body: Developed by the scientific founder of the field of Lipidomics at UC San Diego, the LipoNexus test measures 15 inflammatory lipid biomarkers via mass spectrometry — the same root-cause mechanisms your practice targets. It runs through commercial clinical labs and integrates seamlessly into your existing lab ordering workflow.

features.title: Simple Lab Integration
features.description: A standard blood draw processed through commercial clinical labs — no imaging, no biopsy, no specialist referral required. Fits your existing ordering workflow.

features.title: Highest Accuracy
features.description: Biomarker test achieves the highest sensitivity and specificity of any blood test on the market and is validated against liver biopsy.

features.title: Catch It Before Symptoms
features.description: Identify MASLD at early, fully reversible stages — before symptoms, elevated liver enzymes, or imaging findings appear. Enable true preventive and proactive care.

features.title: Track Treatment Response
features.description: Objectively monitor your patients' response to GLP-1 agonists, dietary protocols, weight loss interventions, and new MASLD/MASH therapeutics over time.

team.headline: Science You Can Trust, Built by Lipidomics and Hepatology Leaders
team.subheadline: Co-founded by the scientific founder of the field of Lipidomics and the leading Key Opinion Leader in Fatty Liver Disease at UC San Diego — the same researchers who define hepatology clinical guidelines.

cta.headline: Bring Precision Liver Diagnostics to Your Practice
cta.body: Your patients deserve early, accurate answers. The LipoNexus test gives you the most sensitive and specific non-invasive MASLD diagnostic available — so you can identify disease early, personalize treatment, and track real outcomes with confidence.
